biography.value:
Description

King behemoths resembles yellow huge bulls with overly developed muscles. They have yellow carapaces and curved obsidian horns. Their eyes crackle with florescent energy, as they froth violently at the mouth.

Defense

AC 29, touch 9; flat-footed 26 (+18 natural, +1 dex, -2 size)

hp 283 [378] (21d10+168)

Fort +19, Ref +13, Will +9

DR 5/adamantine; Immune bleed, curse, daze, sickening, stagger, stun; Resist ice/earth/lightning 5;

Offense

Speed 40 ft.

Melee 2 Claws +29 (1d10+10), Gore +27 (2d6+10)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Impale, Shockwave, Thunderbolt

Statistics

Str 30, Dex 12, Con 24, Int 6, Wis 14, Cha 8

Base Atk +21; CMB +33; CMD 44

Feats Alertness, Charge Through, Cleave, Great Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Natural Attack (Claw), Improved Overrun, Multiattack, Power Attack, Toughness

Skills Acrobatics +14, Climb +22, Perception +19, Survival +15

SQ Death befalls Meteor

description.value: Once a king behemoth reaches below 0 health, the king behemoth calls forth a Meteor (DC 22 Reflex save) on who ever struck the killing blow. If silenced or berserk this affect does nothing.

effect: Below 0 HP only; fails while silenced or berserk. Meteor requires outdoors. Center 20 feet: maximized damage and Evasion reduced one step.
Below 0 HP only; fails while silenced or berserk. Meteor requires outdoors. Center 20 feet: maximized damage and Evasion reduced one step.

description.value: When charging, a king behemoth deals double damage with gore.

effect: Double gore damage on a charge; apply normal charge attack and AC modifiers separately.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, a king behemoth can cause the ground to quake that ripples from it within a 30-ft.-radius spread. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage, inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d6 rounds, and are pushed back 5 feet per 10 damage sustained. A successful Reflex save (DC 22) reduces damage by half, negates the status effect, and stops being pushed back. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

effect: Failure: push 5 feet per 10 damage sustained and inflict Weighted for [[1d6]] rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, a king behemoth can discharge a large lightning storm within 120 ft. and in a 40-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 10d6 points of lightning damage and are inflicted with Static status effect for 1d4 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 22) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).
